verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a customer data platform like mParticle, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents client SDKs, HTTP APIs (Events, Warehouse Sync, Audiences) and UI-based setup, but none of it mentions an official command-line tool. Those APIs and SDKs are developer building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
